about: Classifier setups that tested well in Harvey's own judge test, with what it measured (counts). None is put above another. Read-only: editing one in Settings makes a copy of your own.

results.prompt:
The STATE is one Romanian company's facts from the official registers (they
are true), then the results of a web search for it. Each statement says that one result is the
company's own official website.
results.yes: the result is the company's own site: its own domain, under its name (Romanian names carry a legal form, SRL, S.R.L., SA, PFA, II, IF, that listings often leave out), and nothing in it points to another company or another town.
results.no: company-information sites, directories, listings, marketplaces, social networks, city halls and institutions, news, other companies' sites, and a namesake in another town or abroad are never the company's own site.

site.prompt:
The STATE is one Romanian company's facts from the official registers (they
are true), then what was read on one website: the register facts found on it, other companies'
codes (CUI), the phones' countries, an excerpt and the contacts. The statement says that this
website is the company's own.
site.yes: the same name AND the same town or street, or the company's CUI, registration number, phone or email, are on the website, and nothing makes it another's.
site.no: a shared word is not enough. Company-information sites, directories, marketplaces, city halls, news, a web agency's portfolio, other companies' sites and a namesake in another town or abroad are never the company's own. A PFA, II or IF is one person's business, usually without a site.

contacts.prompt:
The STATE is one Romanian company's facts from the official registers (they
are true), then what was read on the company's own website, with the contacts found there
(c1, c2...: phones, emails, profiles). Each statement says that one contact is the company's
own.
contacts.yes: the phone, email or profile is this company's own way to be reached.
contacts.no: a web agency's or a theme's, another office abroad, a partner's, a platform's, a placeholder or a public hotline is not the company's own.

names.instructions: The website between <page> and </page> names the company (COMPANY): the company's distinctive name appears in the website's domain, title or text. Ignore the legal form (SRL, S.R.L., SA, PFA, II, IF), letter case and diacritics.

criteria.true: the distinctive words of the company's name appear together as the name of the business the site presents.
criteria.false: only one common word is shared, the name is different, or it appears only in a list of many companies.

own.instructions: The website between <page> and </page> presents the business of the company (COMPANY) itself: its own products or services, written by that business, under its name.

directory.instructions: The website between <page> and </page> is a company-information site, business directory, listing, marketplace, classifieds, job board or comparison site that lists many businesses.

institution.instructions: The website between <page> and </page> belongs to a city hall, public institution, government body, school, association, or a news or media outlet.

options.company_own: The company's own phone, email, contact form or social profile
options.agency_or_theme: The web agency's, developer's or website theme's
options.other_office: Another office, branch or company of a group, in another country
options.platform: A platform, marketplace, booking or hosting service's
options.partner_or_other: A partner's, supplier's, client's or another business's
options.placeholder_or_hotline: A placeholder, example value, or a public hotline or institution

scopes.inference: on by default: the classifier's questions
scopes.billing:read: off by default, add it by hand when making the key: Settings shows this month's spend, the key's limit and the balance with it
scopes.metrics: off by default, add it by hand when making the key: usage metrics

DEEPINFRA_API_KEY.note: Leave the scopes Harvey doesn't need off. Every reply carries its own cost (usage.estimated_cost, USD), which Harvey records.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.note: No price list and no billing API: enter the price (0.042 USD a million input tokens, output free) and keep the USD caps.

profiles.name: DeepInfra: Qwen3.8 27B, thinking off
profiles.notes: Only with thinking off (the extra request field reasoning_effort: none): without it the model returns nothing.

profiles.name: TypeSafe: Jev (decision model)
profiles.notes: A decision model, not a chat model: atomic questions, each answered with a probability; Harvey combines them. Site and contacts only (no search-results design). No price list and no billing API: the price is the one entered.

profiles.name: Your own hardware: Ollama, qwen2.5:3b
profiles.notes: A local model on your own machine (Ollama: ollama pull qwen2.5:3b). In Docker the address is the Ollama service's (http://ollama:11434/v1), outside it http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. About 18 s a question on a CPU, under a second on a GPU. The contacts task wasn't measured with today's questions.
